description: Issuance of Building Permits and related ancillary permits (Architectural, Structural, Electrical, Sanitary/Plumbing, Mechanical) by the Office of the Building Official (OBO) / City Engineering Office of Roxas City.
steps: Submit five (5) sets of signed and sealed building plans and Unified Application Form at the OBO receiving counter, City Hall.
Technical review by structural, sanitary, architectural, electrical, and fire safety evaluators.
Receive order of payment and settle building permit fees at the City Treasury.
Claim Building Permit and construction logbook.
requirements: Certified True Copy of Transfer Certificate of Title (TCT) or Contract of Lease / Deed of Absolute Sale
Current Real Property Tax Receipt (Amilyar) and Tax Declaration
Five (5) complete sets of building plans signed and sealed by licensed professionals (Civil/Structural Engineer, Architect, Electrical Engineer, Master Plumber)
Locational / Zoning Clearance from City Planning Office
Fire Safety Evaluation Clearance (FSEC) from BFP Roxas City

quickInfo.whoCanApply: Property and prospective building owners in Roxas City
